mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.created_at, u.username AS author_username, u.display_name AS author_display_name, u.icon_key AS author_icon_key FROM comments c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM comments WHERE post_id = #{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (post_id, user_id, content, created_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{createdAt})
